user.title: Configure vehicle and charger
user.description: Create a profile by assigning each Home Assistant entity its actual role. Read each field explanation: choosing a sensor with different semantics (for example power instead of energy) can produce incorrect sessions, consumption and costs.

data_description.vehicle_name: Vehicle identifier, e.g. Leapmotor C10. Used for the integration device and generated entity names.
data_description.charger_name: Charging point identifier, e.g. Garage wallbox. Each vehicle + charger combination is an independent profile.
data_description.charging_entity: REQUIRED · Binary sensor that is ON while energy is flowing into the vehicle and OFF when charging stops. Do not select connectivity, availability or vehicle ignition. unknown/unavailable are ignored and never end a session. If the source logic is inverted, use a template binary sensor first.
data_description.energy_entity: REQUIRED · Delivered ENERGY sensor, not power. It must report kWh or Wh. It can be a session counter that accumulates from zero during a charge or a cumulative meter that retains its lifetime total; select the matching mode below.
data_description.energy_mode: Choose the exact sensor semantics: Session energy if it counts the current charge from zero and resets between charges; its first valid reading is counted. Cumulative meter if it represents the charger's lifetime total and keeps increasing between sessions; its start reading is stored as a baseline and only later increases are counted. If the counter decreases during a session, a new baseline is established and no negative energy is recorded.
data_description.soc_entity: OPTIONAL · Vehicle battery percentage, unit % and value 0–100. The integration stores the reading available at start and the maximum observed during the session as the final reference. If the car sleeps or the sensor is unavailable/stale, SOC values may be missing or inaccurate. Energy and cost tracking still work without it.
data_description.odometer_entity: OPTIONAL unless odometer finalization is selected · Total distance travelled, normally km or mi. Used to confirm that the vehicle has moved after charging. If it does not increase, the session remains pending. Do not select estimated range.
data_description.odometer_unit: Actual unit reported by the odometer. Values are normalized internally to kilometres. Ensure this matches the source sensor.
data_description.price_mode: Choose the electricity price source. The observed price is saved with each session so later tariff changes do not rewrite historical costs.
data_description.price_per_kwh: Used only for a fixed manual price. Enter the price per kWh, currently expressed as €/kWh. Example: 0.18. Do not use a single average as an exact price if your tariff changes by time.
data_description.price_entity: Used only for sensor pricing. Must be a numeric sensor whose state is the price per kWh and unit is €/kWh. Do not select bill total, contracted power or €/MWh. The value is snapshotted at session start; unavailable or incompatible units leave cost unknown. Price changes during one session are not yet reconstructed.
data_description.finalization: Choose when to close and save a session. Odometer waits for total distance to increase. Immediate closes when charging turns OFF. Manual leaves the session pending until you press the Finalize latest charge button after checking the data.
data_description.power_entity: Optional instantaneous power sensor in W or kW. It improves tariff-period energy allocation; the energy counter remains authoritative for total delivered energy. If unavailable, time-based allocation is used and marked as an estimate.
data_description.plugged_entity: OPTIONAL · Binary sensor indicating that the cable is physically connected to the vehicle. It distinguishes connected-but-idle from disconnected; it does not replace the charging-state sensor.

error.name_required: Enter a vehicle name and charger name.
error.price_sensor_required: Select a price sensor to use automatic pricing.
error.odometer_required: Select an odometer sensor or choose a different finalization method.

abort.already_configured: This vehicle and charger profile is already configured.
abort.options_not_available_yet: Sensor mapping can be edited in a future version.

init.title: Profile settings
init.description: Choose which profile settings to edit. Changing sensor mappings does not delete saved sessions.

periods.title: Edit tariff periods

data_description.period_1_name: Short label shown in the session cost breakdown.
data_description.period_1_start: Local start time in HH:MM format. The start is inclusive.
data_description.period_1_end: Local end time in HH:MM format. The end is exclusive; use 00:00 or 24:00 for midnight.
data_description.period_1_days: Select the weekdays on which this time band applies. The complete weekly schedule must have no gaps or overlaps.
data_description.period_2_name: Short label shown in the session cost breakdown.
data_description.period_2_start: Local start time in HH:MM format. The start is inclusive.
data_description.period_2_end: Local end time in HH:MM format. The end is exclusive; use 00:00 or 24:00 for midnight.
data_description.period_2_days: Select the weekdays on which this time band applies. The complete weekly schedule must have no gaps or overlaps.
data_description.period_3_name: Short label shown in the session cost breakdown.
data_description.period_3_start: Local start time in HH:MM format. The start is inclusive.
data_description.period_3_end: Local end time in HH:MM format. The end is exclusive; use 00:00 or 24:00 for midnight.
data_description.period_3_days: Select the weekdays on which this time band applies. The complete weekly schedule must have no gaps or overlaps.
data_description.period_1_price_source: Choose one source. The manual price and sensor are configured separately on the next step.
data_description.period_2_price_source: Choose one source. The manual price and sensor are configured separately on the next step.
data_description.period_3_price_source: Choose one source. The manual price and sensor are configured separately on the next step.

profile.title: Sensors and behavior
profile.description: Change the entities mapped to the vehicle and charger, energy counter type, and session finalization behavior. Electricity pricing is configured only in Electricity tariffs. Existing history is preserved.

data_description.charging_entity: Must be ON while charging and OFF when stopped. unknown/unavailable never close a session.
data_description.energy_entity: Delivered energy sensor in Wh or kWh, not power.
data_description.energy_mode: Select whether the counter resets each charge or is cumulative.
data_description.range_entity: Optional range sensor reporting the vehicle estimate. Range is never calculated or inferred from SOC.
data_description.odometer_entity: Required when odometer-based finalization is selected.
data_description.odometer_unit: Distance unit reported by the sensor.
data_description.finalization: Choose odometer, automatic after 60 seconds, or manual finalization.
data_description.power_entity: Optional instantaneous power sensor in W or kW. It improves tariff-period energy allocation; the energy counter remains authoritative for total delivered energy. If unavailable, time-based allocation is used and marked as an estimate.
data_description.plugged_entity: Optional binary sensor that is ON while the connector is physically plugged in. It lets the card show a connected cable when the vehicle is not charging.

tariffs.title: Electricity tariff schedule
tariffs.description: Configure one, two or three time-of-use periods. The schedule uses Home Assistant local time and is checked for gaps and overlaps.

units.title: Units and currency
units.description: Choose display units. Source readings are explicitly converted; calculations use canonical units internally. Currency is not converted using exchange rates.

data_description.unit_energy: Energy display unit; calculations remain in kWh.
data_description.unit_distance: Distance display unit; internal distance is normalized to km.
data_description.currency: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code (EUR, USD, GBP, JPY...). No FX conversion is applied.

period_price.title: Configure period price
period_price.description: Period {period_number}: {period_name}. Only the field for the selected source is shown. A manual price must be the final amount actually paid per kWh, including taxes. A selected sensor is the exclusive source.

data_description.price: Enter a non-negative numeric price in the profile currency per kWh, including VAT and all applicable taxes. The integration does not add taxes.
data_description.price_entity: Select a numeric sensor reporting the final price per kWh in the profile currency (for example EUR/kWh). If unavailable or invalid, affected energy remains unpriced; the manual value is never used as a fallback.

vehicle_visual.title: Vehicle appearance
vehicle_visual.description: Personalize the vehicle identity and thumbnail. Use a transparent PNG or WebP stored locally in www/ev-charge-tracker/.

data_description.visual_color: Hexadecimal body color used by the fallback silhouette.
data_description.visual_body_style: Selects the fallback silhouette when no custom image is provided.
data_description.visual_image: Local path, for example /local/ev-charge-tracker/leapmotor-c10.webp. First place the file in the www/ev-charge-tracker folder.
data_description.visual_port_x: Horizontal coordinate of the port center on the image (0–100%). Adjust this so the cable meets the actual port location.
data_description.visual_port_y: Vertical coordinate of the port center on the image (0–100%). Adjust this for custom images with a different perspective.

error.invalid_schedule: The schedule is incomplete or contains overlapping periods. Check the times, weekdays and prices.
error.invalid_currency: Enter a three-letter currency code, for example EUR or USD.
error.invalid_vehicle_color: Enter a valid hexadecimal color, for example #71869A.
error.invalid_vehicle_image: Use a local PNG or WebP image inside /local/ev-charge-tracker/.
